review.why: Writes software, SRE, DevOps and security engineering resumes that keep performance and reliability claims defensible.
review.summary: Establishes the specialty and level, then asks what shipped, the user's part, technical constraints and the observed result, with evidence prompts per target. Performance claims keep their metric and conditions (p95 versus average, load test versus production), reliability and security claims avoid absolutes, and prototypes, tutorials and open-source work are labeled accurately.
strengths: Asks about a design tradeoff, not a list of fashionable technologies
Worked example keeps the load-test qualifier
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Analytics and model work belongs to the data-resume skill
Layout and ATS passage are unverified until the exported file is inspected
